name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
character: The campus features four main north-to-south quads, historic buildings, Boneyard Creek, and a solar calendar with an obelisk and copper fountains.

landmarks.name: Main Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: The Main Quadrangle and South Quadrangle follow immediately after the John Bardeen Quad.
landmarks.look: Large open quadrangle surrounded by liberal arts and sciences buildings.

landmarks.name: Beckman Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: The Beckman Quadrangle, named after Arnold Orville Beckman, is primarily composed of research units and laboratories
landmarks.look: Engineering quad with research buildings, an obelisk, and copper fountains.

landmarks.name: John Bardeen Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: Boneyard Creek flows through the John Bardeen Quadrangle, parallel to Green Street.
landmarks.look: Central engineering quadrangle with a creek flowing through it.

landmarks.name: South Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: The Main Quadrangle and South Quadrangle follow immediately after the John Bardeen Quad.
landmarks.look: Open quadrangle surrounded by agricultural and environmental science buildings.

landmarks.name: Main Library
landmarks.quote: including Harker Hall, the Astronomical Observatory, Louise Freer Hall, the Main Library, the Experimental Dairy Farm Historic District, and the Morrow Plots.

landmarks.name: Grainger Engineering Library
landmarks.quote: including donations for the construction of the Grainger Engineering Library.
